purpose: Machine-readable dispatch contract for process-build. Hooks read this as fallback ground truth when transcript classification is missing or truncated (e.g., after compaction — H11 audit finding 2026-04-18). Prose contract in SKILL.md remains canonical for agent guidance; this file mirrors it for enforcement.

mandatory_dispatches.name: blueprint-mode
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Primary builder for code/n8n/scripts. Replaced by a domain specialist when DOMAIN is set (see classifier routing).

mandatory_dispatches.name: architect-reviewer
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Post-build review is mandatory per task-classifier mandatory-compound rule. Name was previously documented as 'architect-review' (ghost) — consolidated 2026-04-18 H1 fix.

mandatory_dispatches.name: adversarial-reviewer
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Unconditional mandatory reviewer per the 2026-06-11 workflow adoption: process-build.js always dispatches architect-reviewer + adversarial-reviewer together and feeds both into the dual-judge divergence gate. SKILL.md's workflow-enforced header names this pairing, though the Step 4 prose text below it omits adversarial-reviewer; the 2026-08-30 content review closes that gap in the machine contract.

conditional_dispatches.name: prompt-engineer
conditional_dispatches.condition: artifact contains LLM prompts or agent designs

conditional_dispatches.name: mcp-server-architect
conditional_dispatches.condition: MCP domain (server/client build), design review of protocol surface, tool/resource contracts
conditional_dispatches.notes: MUST DISPATCH per architecture-v2 Delta-1 close-out (GAP-5 binding, 2026-07-10). Reclassified 2026-08-30 out of allowed_specialists_via_process_exemption: SKILL.md Step 3 states this as a mandatory row, not an exemption-only allowance.

conditional_dispatches.name: mcp-developer
conditional_dispatches.condition: MCP domain (server/client build), primary implementer, replaces blueprint-mode for the build step
conditional_dispatches.notes: MUST DISPATCH per architecture-v2 Delta-1 close-out (GAP-5 binding, 2026-07-10). Reclassified 2026-08-30 out of allowed_specialists_via_process_exemption: SKILL.md Step 3 states this as a mandatory row, not an exemption-only allowance.

notes: Content tasks route through process-research then content-marketer directly.
